Resolves #20028

A content-sized grid's `resetRowHeights()` no longer leaves the hidden ahead-measure cells of the generation it invalidated. The reset forgot every measured height but kept the projection. The rows it mounts are measured where they show, so the next hidden pass can find nothing nearby to premeasure, and the old cells stayed in the DOM at their old widths. That is the hosted `PremeasureRowsNL:77` red: it read a pre-resize 240 px cell. The reset now retires the projection and its layout, as `updateRowGeometry` already does when row modes switch.

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium e2e for the arm; unit arm red-first) → L3 required (AC-3 is a local run). See Test Evidence.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | `View#resetRowHeights` now clears `#measureLayout` and calls `clearMeasureProjection()`. Unit arm in `PremeasureRows.spec.mjs`, "a height reset retires the hidden projection it invalidates": red on dev ("no cell of the old generation outlives the reset"), green on head. |
| AC-2 | After a resize and reset, the arm scrolls past the reset's first window, so a fresh hidden pass always has rows to measure. One snapshot pins a hidden cell; the poll ends when that cell sits at 213.5 px and the geometry has accepted its record's height. |
| AC-3 | `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs`, whole file ×3 on head: 33 passed. The arm alone ×5: 5 passed. Unit file: see Test Evidence. |

## Deltas from ticket
- Fix part 2 is not an engine change. Once the reset has measured the nearby rows, a hidden pass that finds nothing to do is correct. The defect was the arm's oracle: it sampled whatever projection the DOM held, so it passed only on a stale one (locally a 213.5 px cell left by the resize's own pass, on the hosted red a 240 px one). With the stale cells retired, the unchanged arm went red 3 of 3: the projection is correctly gone, and no new pass follows. The arm now samples a fresh pass instead.
- `clearMeasureProjection` is a `View` method, not `body.clearMeasureProjection` as the ticket cites.

## Test Evidence
- Exact-head receipt with commands, head binding and a dev control: https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20040#issuecomment-6360725114 . E2E whole file ×3 at 540682f95a: 33 passed. The unit file is load-sensitive on dev as well, alternating ×8 at load ~13: head 0 failures, dev 6. The new arm never failed.
